violations.why: ISR can reset v_fjord to 0 after the rand() write (e.g. during init()) and before the task reads it as the argument.
ISR write can land between the task's write at 22 and the read at 13, so the value read differs from the one written.
The range check uses the value read at 8, but the ISR can zero v_fjord before the re-read at 13.
The check was made on the stale value from line 8, and the ISR write is then overwritten by the increment at 13.
The read-modify-write increment is not atomic. The ISR can zero v_fjord between the read and the write-back, and the ISR's reset is lost.
